reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 30 original noun questions: all full German sentences, 120 offered options, naturalness, grammatical forms, contextual uniqueness and bilingual hints/explanations. Compared objectives in production, initial, B2, workplace and general-expansion catalogs. Deferred overlapping Friede/Frieden and Friseur/Frisör variants, Swiss Führerausweis and specialized Funkausstellung/Funktionsraum; corrected Friseur and Fußgänger genders, Funk sense, and incomplete plural metadata. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approvals pending.
